meta.scope: README.md messaging refresh, docs-wide message consistency, and strategic reuse of imported brand assets
assumptions: Somatic Canticles should link to https://1319.tryambakam.space
Existing images in docs/assets/images are the source of truth for immediate reuse
risks: Overloading README with too many visuals can hurt scanability
V1 and V2 image variants can create brand inconsistency
Nested engines/ assets may be large and degrade GitHub load performance

tasks.title: Lock README rewrite scope
tasks.deliverable: A frozen checklist of required README section edits from the approved prompt.
tasks.acceptance: Checklist exists and maps 1:1 to requested sections (opening, philosophy, engines, workflows, closing).

tasks.title: Patch opening philosophy copy
tasks.deliverable: README opening replaced with philosophy-first positioning and Tryambakam link.
tasks.acceptance: Top section contains 'Not prediction. Reflection. Inquiry. Witness.' and links to https://tryambakam.space.

tasks.title: Insert The Philosophy section
tasks.deliverable: New Philosophy section with Problem, Alternative, Kha-Ba-La table, and self-consciousness levels.
tasks.acceptance: Section appears after opening and includes all four required subsections with exact Kha/Ba/La mapping.

tasks.title: Add Somatic Canticles external link
tasks.deliverable: README includes a clickable Somatic Canticles link to 1319.tryambakam.space.
tasks.acceptance: At least one Somatic Canticles mention points to https://1319.tryambakam.space and renders correctly on GitHub.

tasks.title: Contextualize 16 engines section
tasks.deliverable: New intro text framing engines as mirrors with consistent 16-engine language.
tasks.acceptance: Engines section includes both mirror framing and explicit count clarification text.

tasks.title: Reframe workflows section opener
tasks.deliverable: Workflow intro updated from pipeline framing to synthesis/noesis framing.
tasks.acceptance: Section uses 'synthesize' framing and keeps existing workflow table content intact.

tasks.title: Append anti-dependency close
tasks.deliverable: New closing statement after acknowledgments reinforcing independence outcome.
tasks.acceptance: README ends with 'Selemene Engine succeeds when you no longer need it.'

tasks.title: Build asset inventory manifest
tasks.deliverable: A machine-readable inventory of docs/assets/images with filename, variant, and inferred intent tags.
tasks.acceptance: Manifest lists all assets and classifies each by section target (hero, architecture, ritual, brand, engines).

tasks.title: Create visual context index
tasks.deliverable: A markdown index mapping descriptive filenames to message intent and recommended placement.
tasks.acceptance: Every currently used README image has rationale and at least one optional alternate candidate.

tasks.title: Define V1 vs V2 asset policy
tasks.deliverable: Decision doc selecting default visual generation version per section (V2-first unless exception).
tasks.acceptance: Policy explicitly marks approved V1 exceptions and bans mixed variants within same visual block.

tasks.title: Prototype alternate README placements
tasks.deliverable: One proposal for relocating/replacing 3-5 README visuals for stronger narrative flow.
tasks.acceptance: Proposal includes before/after section mapping and estimated scroll/load impact.

tasks.title: Set asset naming metadata convention
tasks.deliverable: Naming+metadata guideline that preserves descriptive filenames while adding normalized tags.
tasks.acceptance: Guideline includes fields for theme, medium, version, and recommended README section.

tasks.title: Publish image usage matrix
tasks.deliverable: Matrix showing used, reusable, and currently-unused image assets with action labels.
tasks.acceptance: Matrix identifies all currently used README assets and flags at least 20 high-value reuse candidates.

tasks.title: Run final README verification pass
tasks.deliverable: Final QA report for links, rendering, wording constraints, and section completeness.
tasks.acceptance: All required links resolve, prohibited vocabulary is absent, and README renders without broken media.

tasks.title: Define docs messaging canon
tasks.deliverable: Single-source messaging canon covering approved tone, terms, and claims for docs.
tasks.acceptance: Canon document includes allowed/forbidden vocabulary and examples aligned to README voice.

tasks.title: Tag docs by audience intent
tasks.deliverable: Classification of markdown docs into marketing-facing, API-facing, ops-facing, and internal-facing sets.
tasks.acceptance: Each targeted markdown file has one primary audience tag and one intent tag.

tasks.title: Audit docs opening paragraphs
tasks.deliverable: Line-by-line inventory of opening sections that conflict with philosophy-first messaging.
tasks.acceptance: Audit lists file path, current opener, and replacement recommendation for each flagged file.

tasks.title: Normalize product naming variants
tasks.deliverable: Standardized naming usage for Selemene Engine, Tryambakam Noesis, and Noesis API across docs.
tasks.acceptance: Naming map is applied to all user-facing docs without changing technical identifiers.

tasks.title: Align API quickstart framing
tasks.deliverable: Updated preface in docs/API_QUICKSTART.md to reflect mirror/inquiry framing while preserving API steps.
tasks.acceptance: Quickstart intro uses approved voice and retains exact runnable command paths.

tasks.title: Align docs/api README preface
tasks.deliverable: Updated docs/api/README.md preface and glossary to match core messaging vocabulary.
tasks.acceptance: API reference remains technical but avoids conflicting positioning language.

tasks.title: Align engines doc introduction
tasks.deliverable: Reframed docs/ENGINES.md intro with mirror-based context and consistent 16-engine language.
tasks.acceptance: ENGINES intro reflects philosophy framing and count distinction without changing engine technical details.

tasks.title: Align workflow docs language
tasks.deliverable: Consistent synthesis terminology in docs/api/workflows.md and related workflow mentions.
tasks.acceptance: Workflow docs use synthesis framing and avoid pipeline-only phrasing where conceptual.

tasks.title: Align LLM agent guide voice
tasks.deliverable: docs/api/LLM_AGENT_GUIDE.md intro and examples aligned to anti-prescriptive framing.
tasks.acceptance: Guide preserves API correctness while framing results as reflective outputs, not directives.

tasks.title: Align bridge CLI README language
tasks.deliverable: bridges/cli/README.md copy updated to match core brand vocabulary where user-facing.
tasks.acceptance: Bridge README keeps technical instructions unchanged and aligns framing language.

tasks.title: Align bridges root README
tasks.deliverable: bridges/README.md messaging and intro synchronized with README positioning.
tasks.acceptance: Root bridge README uses consistent authorship/reflection terms where applicable.

tasks.title: Align deployment README context
tasks.deliverable: docs/deployment/README.md gets concise product-context preface consistent with main docs voice.
tasks.acceptance: Operational instructions remain unchanged; only framing intro is standardized.

tasks.title: Align project overview synopsis
tasks.deliverable: docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md executive summary aligned to latest positioning language.
tasks.acceptance: Overview intro references self-authorship framing without diluting technical findings.

tasks.title: Align release notes narrative
tasks.deliverable: docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md opening and highlights harmonized with current messaging.
tasks.acceptance: Release notes remain factual and include no conflicting dependency-promoting language.

tasks.title: Create docs consistency checklist
tasks.deliverable: Reusable checklist for vocabulary, claims, links, and tone across markdown docs.
tasks.acceptance: Checklist includes pass/fail criteria and can be applied file-by-file.

tasks.title: Build link-map across docs
tasks.deliverable: Comprehensive map of external/internal links in docs with canonical destination recommendations.
tasks.acceptance: Map flags domain inconsistencies and identifies where 1319.tryambakam.space is referenced.

tasks.title: Standardize canonical domain policy
tasks.deliverable: Policy document specifying when to use selemene.tryambakam.space, tryambakam.space, and 1319.tryambakam.space.
tasks.acceptance: Policy includes examples and is applied to all user-facing docs links.

tasks.title: Add Somatic cross-link callouts
tasks.deliverable: Contextual Somatic Canticles callouts added to selected docs where embodiment is discussed.
tasks.acceptance: At least 3 relevant docs include concise callouts linking to https://1319.tryambakam.space.

tasks.title: Document image-placement strategy
tasks.deliverable: Section-by-section strategy for reusing imported images across docs, not just README.
tasks.acceptance: Strategy maps at least 15 currently-unused assets to target markdown locations.

tasks.title: Pilot image reuse in docs
tasks.deliverable: Initial rollout of 5 curated visual insertions across non-README docs.
tasks.acceptance: Pilot preserves readability and all inserted media paths resolve locally and on GitHub.

tasks.title: Run docs-wide vocabulary lint
tasks.deliverable: Report of allowed/disallowed term usage across docs markdown files.
tasks.acceptance: No disallowed messaging terms remain in user-facing introductions unless context-justified.

tasks.title: Finalize docs consistency QA
tasks.deliverable: Final sign-off report for docs-wide messaging consistency and link integrity.
tasks.acceptance: All priority docs pass checklist, links are valid, and messaging aligns with README philosophy-first framing.
